pm_exper_user_4245_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some good outdoor games we could set up for a weekend afternoon get-together with the neighbors?
pm_exper_user_4245_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Given your love for neighborhood basketball games, you might organize a round of HORSE or Knockout so both kids and adults can jump in without the commitment of a full game. Pair that with a frisbee toss or relay races for variety.
(b) If you want a lively afternoon, you could set up a friendly soccer scrimmage for anyone who’s interested, with a second area for lawn games like bocce ball or cornhole. That way there’s a balance between active play and laid-back fun.
(c) Since you already enjoy playing basketball with your neighbors, you could set up a casual half-court 3-on-3 tournament that people can rotate through. Between games, folks could join in on something lighter like cornhole or a giant Jenga set so there’s a mix of energy levels.
(d) You could take the usual basketball fun you share with neighbors and put a twist on it — maybe a timed dribble-and-shoot obstacle course for all ages. Add some picnic blanket board games nearby so people can relax when they’re not on the court.
